checkpoints.name: Step in & stop
checkpoints.action: Have them step fully inside and stop — no talking yet.
checkpoints.ask: Stepping in, does this feel open and right for how you camp?
checkpoints.why: The first unscripted reaction is the most honest read you'll get.

checkpoints.name: First three steps
checkpoints.action: Have them walk their normal first few steps in.
checkpoints.ask: Does moving through these first steps feel natural?
checkpoints.why: Entry bottlenecks show up in movement, not in a photo.

checkpoints.name: Everyone's spot
checkpoints.action: Put everyone in their real sleeping place at once.
checkpoints.ask: Does everyone have a place that actually works?
checkpoints.why: Sleeping capacity on paper rarely matches real bodies.

checkpoints.name: Nightly setup
checkpoints.action: Set up any bed conversion the way they’d do it nightly.
checkpoints.ask: Is the nightly setup something you’d keep doing?
checkpoints.why: A nightly chore they resent kills the deal after purchase.

checkpoints.name: Privacy
checkpoints.action: Show the separation between sleeping zones.
checkpoints.ask: Is there enough separation for your group?
checkpoints.why: Privacy is the top complaint in shared sleeping.

checkpoints.name: Cook your meal
checkpoints.action: Have them mime making the meal they cook most on a trip.
checkpoints.ask: Can you cook the way you actually cook?
checkpoints.why: Prep flow is only visible when they act it out.

checkpoints.name: Food storage
checkpoints.action: Open the fridge, pantry, and drawers.
checkpoints.ask: Is there room for the food you bring?
checkpoints.why: Room for real groceries decides real trips.

checkpoints.name: Outside kitchen
checkpoints.action: Show the outdoor kitchen and what it can and can’t do.
checkpoints.ask: Is the outside kitchen worth it for you?
checkpoints.why: A premium feature only matters if they’d use it.

checkpoints.name: Step in & close
checkpoints.action: Have them step in and close the bathroom door.
checkpoints.ask: Is there room to actually use this comfortably?
checkpoints.why: Real usable space is only clear with the door shut.

checkpoints.name: Stand in the shower
checkpoints.action: Have them step into the shower space.
checkpoints.ask: Does the shower work for your body?
checkpoints.why: Shower fit is a daily make-or-break.

checkpoints.name: Your routine
checkpoints.action: Have them picture their real morning and night routine.
checkpoints.ask: Would your real routine work here?
checkpoints.why: Function beats fixtures.

checkpoints.name: Load your gear
checkpoints.action: Have them picture loading what they actually haul.
checkpoints.ask: Does your gear fit the way you’d load it?
checkpoints.why: Cargo fit is a hard yes/no for their use.

checkpoints.name: Use the space
checkpoints.action: Have them use the flex space the way they would on a trip.
checkpoints.ask: Does this space work for how you’d use it?
checkpoints.why: Multi-use only counts if it works in practice.

checkpoints.name: Exterior storage
checkpoints.action: Open the outside storage and pass-throughs.
checkpoints.ask: Is the outside storage easy to use?
checkpoints.why: Access decides whether it gets used.

checkpoints.name: Outdoor features
checkpoints.action: Show the outdoor entertainment features; tie them to how they camp.
checkpoints.ask: Do these outdoor features add real value for you?
checkpoints.why: Value features only matter if they match the lifestyle.

checkpoints.name: Watch setup
checkpoints.action: Show the leveling and stabilizers operating.
checkpoints.ask: Does setup look manageable to you?
checkpoints.why: Setup ease is a confidence driver.

checkpoints.name: How it works
checkpoints.action: Explain the suspension and leveling in plain terms.
checkpoints.ask: Do you feel confident in this system?
checkpoints.why: Confidence comes from understanding, not specs.

checkpoints.name: This unit's power
checkpoints.action: State plainly what solar, battery, and inverter this unit has.
checkpoints.ask: Will this power setup support how and where you camp?
checkpoints.why: They can’t judge power by looking — teach first.

checkpoints.name: Off-grid needs
checkpoints.action: Tie the power to their real trips and any upgrade path.
checkpoints.ask: Is the power here enough, or would you upgrade?
checkpoints.why: Match the system to their actual off-grid time.

checkpoints.name: What matters
checkpoints.action: Highlight only the differences that matter to this customer.
checkpoints.ask: Which standout difference actually matters to you?
checkpoints.why: Differentiators mean nothing in the abstract.

checkpoints.ask: Stepping in, does this feel open and right for how you camp?
checkpoints.why: The first unscripted reaction is the most honest read you'll get.

checkpoints.name: First three steps
checkpoints.action: Have them walk their normal first few steps in.
checkpoints.ask: Does moving through these first steps feel natural?
checkpoints.why: Entry bottlenecks show up in movement, not in a photo.

checkpoints.name: Everyone's spot
checkpoints.action: Put everyone in their real sleeping place at once.
checkpoints.ask: Does everyone have a place that actually works?
checkpoints.why: Sleeping capacity on paper rarely matches real bodies.

checkpoints.name: Nightly setup
checkpoints.action: Set up any bed conversion the way they’d do it nightly.
checkpoints.ask: Is the nightly setup something you’d keep doing?
checkpoints.why: A nightly chore they resent kills the deal after purchase.

checkpoints.name: Privacy
checkpoints.action: Show the separation between sleeping zones.
checkpoints.ask: Is there enough separation for your group?
checkpoints.why: Privacy is the top complaint in shared sleeping.

checkpoints.name: Cook your meal
checkpoints.action: Have them mime making the meal they cook most on a trip.
checkpoints.ask: Can you cook the way you actually cook?
checkpoints.why: Prep flow is only visible when they act it out.

checkpoints.name: Food storage
checkpoints.action: Open the fridge, pantry, and drawers.
checkpoints.ask: Is there room for the food you bring?
checkpoints.why: Room for real groceries decides real trips.

checkpoints.name: Outside kitchen
checkpoints.action: Show the outdoor kitchen and what it can and can’t do.
checkpoints.ask: Is the outside kitchen worth it for you?
checkpoints.why: A premium feature only matters if they’d use it.

checkpoints.name: Step in & close
checkpoints.action: Have them step in and close the bathroom door.
checkpoints.ask: Is there room to actually use this comfortably?
checkpoints.why: Real usable space is only clear with the door shut.

checkpoints.name: Stand in the shower
checkpoints.action: Have them step into the shower space.
checkpoints.ask: Does the shower work for your body?
checkpoints.why: Shower fit is a daily make-or-break.

checkpoints.name: Your routine
checkpoints.action: Have them picture their real morning and night routine.
checkpoints.ask: Would your real routine work here?
checkpoints.why: Function beats fixtures.

checkpoints.name: Load your gear
checkpoints.action: Have them picture loading what they actually haul.
checkpoints.ask: Does your gear fit the way you’d load it?
checkpoints.why: Cargo fit is a hard yes/no for their use.

checkpoints.name: Use the space
checkpoints.action: Have them use the flex space the way they would on a trip.
checkpoints.ask: Does this space work for how you’d use it?
checkpoints.why: Multi-use only counts if it works in practice.

checkpoints.name: Exterior storage
checkpoints.action: Open the outside storage and pass-throughs.
checkpoints.ask: Is the outside storage easy to use?
checkpoints.why: Access decides whether it gets used.

checkpoints.name: Outdoor features
checkpoints.action: Show the outdoor entertainment features; tie them to how they camp.
checkpoints.ask: Do these outdoor features add real value for you?
checkpoints.why: Value features only matter if they match the lifestyle.

checkpoints.name: Watch setup
checkpoints.action: Show the leveling and stabilizers operating.
checkpoints.ask: Does setup look manageable to you?
checkpoints.why: Setup ease is a confidence driver.

checkpoints.name: How it works
checkpoints.action: Explain the suspension and leveling in plain terms.
checkpoints.ask: Do you feel confident in this system?
checkpoints.why: Confidence comes from understanding, not specs.

checkpoints.name: This unit's power
checkpoints.action: State plainly what solar, battery, and inverter this unit has.
checkpoints.ask: Will this power setup support how and where you camp?
checkpoints.why: They can’t judge power by looking — teach first.

checkpoints.name: Off-grid needs
checkpoints.action: Tie the power to their real trips and any upgrade path.
checkpoints.ask: Is the power here enough, or would you upgrade?
checkpoints.why: Match the system to their actual off-grid time.

checkpoints.name: What matters
checkpoints.action: Highlight only the differences that matter to this customer.
checkpoints.ask: Which standout difference actually matters to you?
checkpoints.why: Differentiators mean nothing in the abstract.

checkpoints.name: Step in & stop
checkpoints.action: Have them step fully inside and stop — no talking yet.
checkpoints.ask: Stepping in, does this feel open and right for how you camp?
checkpoints.why: The first unscripted reaction is the most honest read you'll get.

checkpoints.name: First three steps
checkpoints.action: Have them walk their normal first few steps in.
checkpoints.ask: Does moving through these first steps feel natural?
checkpoints.why: Entry bottlenecks show up in movement, not in a photo.

checkpoints.name: Everyone's spot
checkpoints.action: Put everyone in their real sleeping place at once.
checkpoints.ask: Does everyone have a place that actually works?
checkpoints.why: Sleeping capacity on paper rarely matches real bodies.

checkpoints.name: Nightly setup
checkpoints.action: Set up any bed conversion the way they’d do it nightly.
checkpoints.ask: Is the nightly setup something you’d keep doing?
checkpoints.why: A nightly chore they resent kills the deal after purchase.

checkpoints.name: Privacy
checkpoints.action: Show the separation between sleeping zones.
checkpoints.ask: Is there enough separation for your group?
checkpoints.why: Privacy is the top complaint in shared sleeping.

checkpoints.name: Cook your meal
checkpoints.action: Have them mime making the meal they cook most on a trip.
checkpoints.ask: Can you cook the way you actually cook?
checkpoints.why: Prep flow is only visible when they act it out.

checkpoints.name: Food storage
checkpoints.action: Open the fridge, pantry, and drawers.
checkpoints.ask: Is there room for the food you bring?
checkpoints.why: Room for real groceries decides real trips.

checkpoints.name: Outside kitchen
checkpoints.action: Show the outdoor kitchen and what it can and can’t do.
checkpoints.ask: Is the outside kitchen worth it for you?
checkpoints.why: A premium feature only matters if they’d use it.

checkpoints.name: Step in & close
checkpoints.action: Have them step in and close the bathroom door.
checkpoints.ask: Is there room to actually use this comfortably?
checkpoints.why: Real usable space is only clear with the door shut.

checkpoints.name: Stand in the shower
checkpoints.action: Have them step into the shower space.
checkpoints.ask: Does the shower work for your body?
checkpoints.why: Shower fit is a daily make-or-break.

checkpoints.name: Your routine
checkpoints.action: Have them picture their real morning and night routine.
checkpoints.ask: Would your real routine work here?
checkpoints.why: Function beats fixtures.

checkpoints.name: Load your gear
checkpoints.action: Have them picture loading what they actually haul.
checkpoints.ask: Does your gear fit the way you’d load it?
checkpoints.why: Cargo fit is a hard yes/no for their use.

checkpoints.name: Use the space
checkpoints.action: Have them use the flex space the way they would on a trip.
checkpoints.ask: Does this space work for how you’d use it?
checkpoints.why: Multi-use only counts if it works in practice.

checkpoints.name: Exterior storage
checkpoints.action: Open the outside storage and pass-throughs.
checkpoints.ask: Is the outside storage easy to use?
checkpoints.why: Access decides whether it gets used.

checkpoints.name: Outdoor features
checkpoints.action: Show the outdoor entertainment features; tie them to how they camp.
checkpoints.ask: Do these outdoor features add real value for you?
checkpoints.why: Value features only matter if they match the lifestyle.

checkpoints.name: Watch setup
checkpoints.action: Show the leveling and stabilizers operating.
checkpoints.ask: Does setup look manageable to you?
checkpoints.why: Setup ease is a confidence driver.

checkpoints.name: How it works
checkpoints.action: Explain the suspension and leveling in plain terms.
checkpoints.ask: Do you feel confident in this system?
checkpoints.why: Confidence comes from understanding, not specs.

checkpoints.name: This unit's power
checkpoints.action: State plainly what solar, battery, and inverter this unit has.
checkpoints.ask: Will this power setup support how and where you camp?
checkpoints.why: They can’t judge power by looking — teach first.

checkpoints.name: Off-grid needs
checkpoints.action: Tie the power to their real trips and any upgrade path.
checkpoints.ask: Is the power here enough, or would you upgrade?
checkpoints.why: Match the system to their actual off-grid time.

checkpoints.name: What matters
checkpoints.action: Highlight only the differences that matter to this customer.
checkpoints.ask: Which standout difference actually matters to you?
checkpoints.why: Differentiators mean nothing in the abstract.

checkpoints.ask: Is the power here enough, or would you upgrade?
checkpoints.why: Match the system to their actual off-grid time.

checkpoints.name: What matters
checkpoints.action: Highlight only the differences that matter to this customer.
checkpoints.ask: Which standout difference actually matters to you?
checkpoints.why: Differentiators mean nothing in the abstract.
